_comment: Server-controlled employee benchmark registry. A benchmark is usable only through the frozen dataset digest, scoring version and task scope pinned here. Changing any of them is a new benchmark attempt; a prior AgentExecution record that no longer matches becomes ineligible on revalidation. This registry is not a leaderboard and grants no routing or effect authority by itself.

task_scope.task_policy: Deliver an accurate, cited industrial quote from the authorized price list under the taught terms, and reconcile the supplier invoice against the purchase order and receiving records; prepare only the supported review document and perform no unsupported external effect.
